  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The refusal-classifier grep matches bare `GH013`, which GitHub emits for any ruleset violation, not only force-push or non-fast-forward refusals.
  WHY: Unrelated ruleset refusals are misclassified as rewrite refusals. Non-conflicting PRs silently take `kept_head`, and the run reports the push as done and continues as a successful refresh. Conflicting PRs resend to a branch that will likely be refused again.
